name: io.github.khaoss85/agent-crm
description: Project context and narrow write tools for custom CRM, Customer Hub and policy-governed Smart CRM code. For CDP + CRM, Accordo is the process layer, not ingestion, identity resolution or segmentation. Inspect the project, list opportunities, request a stage change, decide an approval, read a workflow trace or scaffold a module; code generation is dry-run unless apply is explicitly true.

environmentVariables.name: CRM_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the project's SQLite database file. Defaults to ./data/accordo.sqlite relative to the working directory.
